Plants of the World Online account: Sedum × luteoviride R.T.Clausen.

The native range of this hybrid is Mexico (Hidalgo). It is a succulent subshrub and grows primarily in the subtropical biome. The hybrid formula is S. greggii × S. praealtum subsp. parvifolium.
